Aileen Villas Layan

Villa in Layan
HomeNew ProjectsAileen Villas Layan

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Phase 5 of the Aileen Villas Layan community by Trinity Property, offering 3 and 4 bedroom private-pool villas of roughly 270 to 470 sqm. Larger types add a terrace pool or extra laundry and storage rooms. Sources disagree on whether the phase is finished or still to be completed.

Facilities & amenities

  • Private pool in each villa
  • Parking
